description.en: 18+ reskin: every goods is renamed to adult-shop products (vibrating eggs, flesh sleeves, bondage rope, love potions, silk lingerie, magic wands...). Client-side only. Includes themed avatars.
description.zh: 18+ 换皮模组：把全部货物换成情趣用品店的劲爆商品（跳蛋、名器、束缚绳、爱情灵药、丝绸情趣内衣、震动棒……），仅客户端生效，附配套主题头像。

description.en: Fantasy reskin with arcane goods: fey fruit, familiar hens, arcane staves and elven wine. Client-side only. Includes themed avatars matching the reskin.
description.zh: 魔法世界观换皮：仙灵果、使魔母鸡、奥术法杖与精灵酒等秘法货物。仅客户端生效。附带配套主题头像。

description.en: Half of every accepted bribe goes into a public pot split equally at game end.
description.zh: 每笔被接受的赏金有一半进入公开赏金池，结束时均分。

description.en: Neon reskin with iconic cyberpunk goods: rail-guns, neuro-stims, night-brew and memory silk. Client-side only. Includes themed avatars matching the reskin.
description.zh: 霓虹赛博风格：磁轨枪、神经兴奋剂、夜酿与记忆丝绸等未来都市货物。仅客户端生效。附带配套主题头像。

description.en: Secret delivery contracts at game start; fulfilled ones pay gold at the end.
description.zh: 开局发放秘密契约，完成后结算金币奖励。

description.en: Rule mod: lengthens the match to 3 rounds per player (4 for 3-player games). All players in a room need this mod installed.
description.zh: 规则模组：延长对局，每名玩家默认两回合改为三回合（3人局为4回合）。房间内所有玩家都需安装此模组。

description.en: Medieval reskin with period goods: fattened capons, monastery cheese, oat loaves and monks' mead. Client-side only. Includes themed avatars matching the reskin.
description.zh: 中世纪换皮：肥育阉鸡、修道院奶酪、燕麦面包与修士蜜酒等时代货物。仅客户端生效。附带配套主题头像。

description.en: Rule mod: truthful inspections raise reputation +1, getting caught with contraband lowers it -1 (mismatched legal goods do NOT cost reputation). Reputation biases deck draws: positive reputation draws more legal cards (gradient, ~90% at rep 5), negative reputation draws more contraband (capped ~70%, leaving room to recover). Perks at 1/3/5: +1 market discard, -10% fines, refill to 7 cards.
description.zh: 玩法模组：查实说真话声望 +1，被查出违禁品声望 -1（仅合法货物与申报不同不扣声望）。声望影响抽牌：正声望抽到合法货概率梯度上升（声望5约90%），负声望抽到违禁品概率上升但封顶约70%，留有翻盘余地。1/3/5 点额外解锁：市场多弃1张、罚金-10%、补牌至7张。

description.en: 40-second action timer per phase; timeout auto-plays a sensible default.
description.zh: 每个阶段 40 秒动作倒计时，超时自动执行默认动作。

description.en: Royal cards build favor; milestones 2/4/6 pay +6/+10/+18 instantly.
Rule mod: adds a new legal goods (Pepper) and a new contraband (Tea). All players in a room need this mod installed.
description.zh: 规则模组：新增合法货物胡椒与违禁品茶叶。房间内所有玩家都需安装此模组。

description.en: Space-faring reskin with colony goods: hydroponic fruit, protein slabs, plasma rifles and nebula wine. Client-side only. Includes themed avatars matching the reskin.
description.zh: 星际殖民换皮：水培果、蛋白块、等离子步枪与星云酒等殖民地货物。仅客户端生效。附带配套主题头像。

description.en: Steampunk reskin with brass-age goods: clockwork fowl, cog-cheese, steam rifles and coal whiskey. Client-side only. Includes themed avatars matching the reskin.
description.zh: 蒸汽朋克换皮：发条禽、齿轮奶酪、蒸汽步枪与煤烟威士忌等黄铜时代货物。仅客户端生效。附带配套主题头像。

description.en: A public route per round; +4 gold per legal route card delivered past the sheriff.
description.zh: 每回合公开商路，指定法定货物每张过关 +4 金。

description.en: Rule mod: N Wild Cards are shuffled into the deck (host sets the count in the lobby). A Wild Card in a declared bag automatically becomes the declared legal goods. Legal goods, never confiscated.
description.zh: 玩法模组：牌库中加入 n 张万能卡（房主在大厅设置数量）。申报时袋中的万能卡自动变成所申报的合法货物，属于合法品不会被没收。

description.en: Rule mod: once per round the sheriff may pay gold equal to the total cards still in un-inspected bags to learn how many of them are contraband (reported as 0-2 / 3-5 / ...). Needs 2+ merchants left to inspect.
description.zh: 玩法模组：每回合警长有一次机会支付金币（等于剩余未查玩家袋中物品数量之和），获知剩余袋中违禁品的数量区间（0-2 / 3-5 依此类推）。仅当待查商人不少于两人时可用。

description.en: Rule mod: adds one Super card per contraband type - triple the value and triple the fine (e.g. Super Coffee 18g / Super Crossbow 27g). Behave exactly like contraband when inspected.
description.zh: 玩法模组：每种违禁品加入一张超级违禁品，价值与罚金均为该类普通违禁品的三倍（如超级咖啡价值18、超级弩价值27）。被检查时按普通违禁品同样没收并罚款。

description.en: Rule mod: one public event is revealed at the start of each round and lasts until round end. 20 medium/low events: Bountiful Harvest (+1 market draw), Famine (bag max 4), Plague (one legal good banned from bags; wild cards cannot become it), Market Day (truthful pay +1/card), Tax Levy (1 gold to seal), Inspector Visit (must inspect at least 1), Lockdown (contraband fines x2), Amnesty Day (seized without fine), Black Market Boom (smuggled contraband +1 value), Rumors (sheriff peeks 1 card), Apple Blight (apples banned from bags), Cheese Festival (cheese +1 value), Zero Tolerance (contraband fines +3), Double Compensation (truthful pay x2), Shortage (market discard max 4), Parade Day (+3 gold per smuggler at round end), Bounty Board (+5 gold first smuggler), Sheriff Payday (+3 gold per confiscated card), Rumors Pro (peek 1 card per merchant), Royal Treasury (bribes up to 2x gold).
description.zh: 玩法模组：每回合开始公开 1 张事件卡，本回合内生效。20 个中低难度事件：丰收之年（市场多摸1张）、饥荒之年（装袋上限4张）、瘟疫蔓延（随机合法货禁运，万能卡也不能变）、集市日（查实赔偿+1金/张）、城门税（装袋缴1金）、官员视察（警长必须至少查1人）、全城封锁（违禁品罚款翻倍）、恩赦日（只没收不罚款）、黑市行情（走私违禁品价值+1）、街头谣言（警长偷看1张牌）、苹果歉收（苹果禁装袋）、奶酪盛典（奶酪价值+1）、零容忍（违禁品罚金+3）、双倍赔偿（查实赔偿翻倍）、物资短缺（市场最多弃4张）、游园日（回合末走私者各+3金）、赏金榜（首位走私者+5金）、警长加薪（每没收一件+3金）、谣言升级（每人可偷看1张）、金库充盈（贿赂上限2倍）。局内聊天栏上方常驻事件详情。
